trace.notes: Normalized the input as the zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/579434. Local resolver metadata in outputs/shards/open-problems-shard-0.csv identifies the record as year 1993 with DOI 10.2307/2324790 and notes that zbMATH Open Web Interface contents are unavailable due to conflicting licenses.

Recovered the exact work title from source-adjacent resolver pages as James Currie, 'Open Problems in Pattern Avoidance,' The American Mathematical Monthly, volume 100, issue 8, pages 790-793. The JSTOR issue page https://www.jstor.org/stable/i315234 exposes article, Download, and XML links for the exact stable article, and the Taylor & Francis issue page https://www.tandfonline.com/toc/uamm20/100/8 lists a PDF link, but the readable article PDF/XML could not be fetched in this environment. Local curl attempts to zbmath.org, jstor.org, and doi.org failed with DNS resolution errors.

Bounded exact-work recovery searched the DOI, exact title plus PDF, exact title plus author, JSTOR stable/PDF/XML endpoints, Taylor & Francis issue listing, and Dialnet metadata at https://dialnet.unirioja.es/servlet/articulo?codigo=363789. Candidates were rejected because they were metadata-only, explicitly lacked full text, or could not provide a readable exact-work artifact. No questions were extracted from metadata, snippets, abstracts, or related papers.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/579434.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
